dossier_04_mapping.step1_snapshot_and_aliasing: RowDescriptor snapshots decided naming values at the serial boundaries (output-folder precedence, 'Results'->name after the skip gate only) without mutating live Settings; alias detection by object identity BEFORE snapshotting
dossier_04_mapping.step2_dependency_edges: output_conflict (same canonical folder + prefix-overlapping stems — proven complete for the actual writers), read_write (either direction; five input fields incl. obstacle and observer files; symlink-resolved; case-insensitive), aliased_settings; separator-stem writers are UNCONTAINABLE -> batch-wide serial; skipped/error rows excluded as sources
dossier_04_mapping.step3_ordered_outcomes: per-row validation held in caller order with serial-exact semantics: ok / skipped (falsy) / error (truthy non-strings, non-string data_folder through both failure transitions, unreadable attributes); planner raises only for the whole-call empty-batch precondition
dossier_04_mapping.step4_admission: worker only when proven independent AND exact Settings type; uncontained writers force batch-wide serial; everything else serial WITH a reason; independent rows admitted even when neighbors are serialized
dossier_04_mapping.steps5-7: delivered as the executable specification: ROW_TRANSITIONS (annotated: bind+resolve run for skipped rows too) / BATCH_TRANSITIONS + verify_prefix + BatchPlan.commit_order (truncated at the earliest error)/fold_order; the BATCH_EXEC runtime reproduces these against real workers
dossier_04_mapping.formal_invariant: verify_prefix implements S_i == C_i after EVERY committed row; tests simulate a correct coordinator (passes) and both dossier mutants (publish-out-of-order, fold-by-completion) — both selected, reviewer confirmed non-vacuous
dossier_04_mapping.failure_ordering: the serial call aborts at the earliest row-position failure: the plan's commit_order finishes the valid prefix and stops at the first error row (dossier 04 failure ordering)
dossier_04_mapping.timestamps: output_wStamp rows are NOT serialized for the clock alone (file basenames derive from the stem); the plan notes that the runtime resolves timestamps under its clock discipline and never predicts them
dossier_04_mapping.composite: batch composite artifacts are coordinator-written after the last commit; the plan notes this explicitly when any row requests composite output; fold order is plan.fold_order (order-sensitive float sum, bit-tested)

limitations: Planner-only scope: no worker pool, no reorder buffer, no cancellation/checkpoint (BATCH_EXEC). RunBatch(parallel=True) still raises ExecutionNotAdmittedError in this tree — unchanged serial behavior.

Dependency analysis is deliberately conservative in documented directions: case-insensitive path comparison, stem-prefix output conflicts, and batch-wide serialization under an uncontained (separator-stem) writer. Each can only over-serialize, never corrupt.
Row-level runtime errors hold the serial abort-at-earliest-failure semantics at PLAN level; the runtime re-implements them for execution-stage failures (dossier 04 failure ordering).
